description: qou-pdix. The bean's remaining job is to produce M with M.trace = 2*cos(alpha(q)) and M.det = 1 from the Hecke seminormal rep on V_(2,1). Nobody had asked what those two fields force about M at the classical point. They force three things: alpha(1) = 0 (its t^1 coefficient is z(1)-1 = -1/2 under BOTH conventions), so tr M(1) = 2 with det = 1 gives charpoly (x-1)^2 and M(1) is UNIPOTENT; tr M has no t^1 term; and its t^2 coefficient is -1/4. Corollary: if M normalises a braid word's image then M(1) is semisimple (Maschke), and unipotent + semisimple forces M(1) = I — so no braid-word carrier unless the word degenerates to the identity permutation, a second and simpler reason for route 1's closure. The filter is CONVENTION-BLIND through t^2 (tr M = 2 - t^2/4 for both; they first differ at t^3, 1/4 vs 5/4), which refines the acceptance test: matching alpha through t^2 on the trace shows nothing about which convention. Applied: Delta_L — this session's Step 26 result, the corpus's ONLY elliptic operator and so the only one clearing TIER-0 D0 — has tr M(1) = 2cos(2pi/3) = -1 and fails at ORDER ZERO, structurally, because its leading direction is -(1 + T_1 T_0) with T_1 T_0 the S_3 three-cycle. Delta_S is hyperbolic at every real q. The S_3 character table was checked FIRST as the falsifier.

assertions.name: s3_standard_rep_has_trace_two_only_at_the_identity
assertions.detail: chi^(2,1) is +2 on e, 0 on the transpositions and -1 on the 3-cycles, so trace 2 identifies the identity class uniquely. Checked first because the whole filter turns on it: had a non-identity class had trace 2, the constraint would collapse to 'tr M(1) = 2' alone

assertions.name: carrier_classical_limit_is_unipotent_and_the_trace_is_stationary
assertions.detail: alpha(1) = 0 in both conventions (its t^1 coefficient is z(1)-1 = -1/2 for each), so tr M(1) = 2 with det M(1) = 1 gives charpoly (x-1)^2 and M(1) is UNIPOTENT — not necessarily I, since at q=1 the (2,1) block is all of M_2(C). Further, tr M has no t^1 term and its t^2 coefficient is -1/4. Three necessary conditions, cheap enough to disqualify a candidate before any construction is attempted

assertions.name: no_braid_word_carrier_unless_it_degenerates_to_the_identity
assertions.detail: if M normalises a single braid word's image then M(1) lies in the S_3 image, which is semisimple by Maschke and so diagonalisable; unipotent AND diagonalisable forces M(1) = I, so the word must degenerate to the identity permutation. Route 1 (braid image) is already closed in this bean by another argument — this is a second, simpler reason that needs only the classical point and no eigenphase computation

assertions.name: the_filter_is_convention_blind_through_t2
assertions.detail: tr M = 2 - t^2/4 + O(t^3) IDENTICALLY for z_C and z_D, because the t^2 coefficient of the trace depends only on alpha's t^1 coefficient, which is z(1)-1 = -1/2 for both. They first differ at t^3 (1/4 vs 5/4). So the acceptance test's 'reproduce alpha through t^2', read on the TRACE, shows nothing about which convention a construction belongs to. The alpha expansions reproduce entry 6's recorded coefficients (C: 1/4, -5/16; D: 5/4) independently

assertions.name: delta_L_the_only_D0_operator_fails_the_carrier_test_at_order_zero
assertions.detail: Step 26 established Delta_L as the corpus's only ELLIPTIC operator, the only one clearing TIER-0 condition D0. A carrier needs tr M(1) = +2; Delta_L gives 2*cos(2*pi/3) = -1. Structural rather than a near-miss: its leading direction at q=1 is -(1 + T_1 T_0) and T_1 T_0 is the S_3 three-cycle, whose character is -1 by the table above. Delta_S is excluded more simply — hyperbolic at every real q, so no eigenphase

assertions.name: parabolic_locus_separates_and_its_centre_stratum_is_scalar
assertions.detail: the scale-invariant condition is R := tr^2/det = 4 at q = 1, i.e. the underlying operator is PARABOLIC there. Writing A = sum c_b B_b, disc A(1) = 4*Q_T - 3*(c3-c4)^2 with Q_T the half-sum of squared pairwise differences of the three transposition coefficients, so the locus is 2[(c1-c2)^2+(c1-c5)^2+(c2-c5)^2] = 3(c3-c4)^2. c_0 is absent (disc is translation-invariant) and the transposition coefficients enter only through their differences, since chi^(2,1) vanishes on a transposition. Q_T = 0 <=> c1=c2=c5 <=> c3=c4 on the locus, and that stratum is the CENTRE of C[S_3], acting as a scalar on the (2,1) block — so M(1) = I exactly there

assertions.name: the_filter_is_a_disqualifier_not_a_target
assertions.detail: condition 1 is ONE quadratic equation on the six c_b(1); conditions 2 and 3 constrain the first and second derivatives of the c_b at q = 1, two more equations on twelve new parameters. Cumulative: 3 equations on 18 parameters. The filter rules candidates out cheaply — including both operators the qou-cds1 arc produced — but it does NOT tell a construction what to be. Corrects the recommendation this probe's first version implied
